activity_summary: At nine you rehearsed at the Cross Keys. Garnish kept Thursday's two stops and did not take a third. Nick was not fetched, and the songs stayed as they were. You were not in the afternoon's Knave, and you said so. Kemp was civil. You did not open a tally. You told the room Davy's forty ships and did not correct the number. Nothing was bought.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a tally, named the forty ships, and said he was not in the Knave.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Stayed civil and offered no addition to be written down.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked for a known door and refused to rehearse a thinner house a day early.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Kept the two stops, kept the new comedy off the afternoon plot, and sent the pass.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Held the songs and left Nick and Sam uncalled.

entities.name: the Knave
entities.context: Mentioned in The tally stays shut

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: Keep your tally shut and I will keep my additions in my mouth.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have nothing to set under your name.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Two stops, and I will not take a third off you because a morning is long.
